item.title: Ex-NYPD detective admits he ran COVID loan fraud scheme, faces up to 5 years
item.description: Detective John Bolden, 48, a 20-year NYPD veteran who retired from the force in October, pleaded guilty to wire fraud conspiracy, admitting to his role in the scheme to fleece the federal Paycheck Protection Program.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 19, 2026
item.description: Small sparks could lead to brave starts now. With the emotional Moon entering bold Aries at 2:39 pm EST, following our impulses may be easier than usual. Soon after, Luna meets restrictive Saturn, asking for measured steps, simple promises, and patience as we shape plans we can actually keep. Moments later, the Moon’s contact with dreamy Neptune softens edges, encouraging us to listen from the heart. item.title: US defeats Sweden to reach semifinals at Olympics
item.description: When the U.S. gave up a tying goal to Sweden with 91 seconds left in the quarterfinals at the Olympics, even the most seasoned players were on edge.

item.title: Most shocking moments from ‘America’s Next Top Model’ documentary
item.description: From shocking to seriously problematic, here are the biggest bombshells revealed in “Reality Check: Inside America’s Next Top Model.”

item.title: NY jury urged to acquit suspect in Chinatown slayings by reason of insanity
item.description: Marnie Zien from the Legal Aid Society said there would be no justice in holding the 31-year-old Santos criminally liable for actions he took in a state of psychosis.

item.title: U2 debuts protest song honoring Minneapolis activist Renee Good
item.description: U2's new song "American Obituary" honors Renee Good, who was killed by federal agents while opposing ICE operations in Minneapolis.

item.title: MTA Inspector General: LIRR official got son job with railroad contractor
item.description: An official with the Long Island Rail Road used his position as an assistant chief program officer to land his son a job with railroad contractors, the MTA Inspector General said in a report Wednesday.

item.title: New suspect ID’d in fatal 2024 hit-and-run that killed Queens bicyclist
item.description: Nedzad Korac, 53, is being sought in connection to the deadly crash that claimed the life of 36-year-old Amanda Servedio on Oct. 22, 2024, cops said.

item.title: Rapper Lil Poppa, 25, dies in Georgia, cause being investigated
item.description: The Florida rapper known as Lil Poppa died Wednesday, less than a week after releasing his latest song. Janarious Mykel Wheeler was 25.
